notes.title: Playtest update 0.1.9 - Room
notes.content:
[p]Hello! I've been preparing this update to show the new Lobby so hope you like it! And of course a lot of fixes and changes too.


[b]------------------------------------------- CHANGES -------------------------------------------[/b] [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Balance enemies, damage, and health, especially at the beginning of the game.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Balancing enemy spawns so that higher-level enemies cannot appear and it is unfair due to the difference in stats. The enemy level starts at 0 and, unless modified by a tile effect, this value will only increase as you progress through the map, increasing the enemy pool and therefore the difficulty.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Changes in how selections work. chests, shops, leveling up,twilights. Previously, it was a fixed value that only changed with Tile effects. This could be a bit inconsistent, so to place greater emphasis on risk reward, the number of selections will be modified by the size of the map.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fix hover enemies pause unpause. When the player hovers an enemy the combat continues that makes it hard to follow. Now when an enemy is hover the combat pauses.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fix some description texts.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Standard magic ability stamina points changed from 3 to 2.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Input actions bug fixed. On Change scene to back to the lobby the inputs crash and throw errors, now when the scene is changed it clear all input events first.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Item IDs bug fixed. There where some items without IDs, now all the Items have an ID and another ID for the specific lists that help to check items in the code.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]------------------------------------------- NEW -------------------------------------------[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New lobby sprites room implemented.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]New menu where the player can check all items from the game. Try and Unlock all :).[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Now the actions info from the Lobby room have texts to remark what button is neccesary and if it is hold or press action.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Change background combat to be more clear when enemies sprites are too darker and was difficult to see at combat.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added new feedback form at start. A google form where you can send feedback about what do you think. It helps a lot![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Little animation on Menu that follow the mouse in a radius, I think it gives a cool 3D effect :)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Again thanks all for play the Playtest, it helps a lot to know what you think about the actual state of game.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is still in an early version but I will keep updating and adding content so hope you keep playing it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/ec739795a7efb629a1d2d968bb14c54ee16676a0.gif"][/img][/p]

tags.balance_change: - Balance magic ability stamina points changed from 3 to 2.

tags.bug: - Fix hover enemies pause unpause. When the player hovers an enemy the combat continues that makes it hard to follow. Now when an enemy is hover the combat pauses.
- Input actions bug fixed. On Change scene to back to the lobby the inputs crash and throw errors, now when the scene is changed it clear all input events first.
- Item IDs bug fixed. There where some items without IDs, now all the Items have an ID and another ID for the specific lists that help to check items in the code.

tags.feature: - New menu where the player can check all items from the game. Try and Unlock all :).
- Now the actions info from the Lobby room have texts to remark what button is neccesary and if it is hold or press action.
- Change background combat to be more clear when enemies sprites are too darker and was difficult to see at combat.
- Added new feedback form at start. A google form where you can send feedback about what do you think. It helps a lot!
- Little animation on Menu that follow the mouse in a radius, I think it gives a cool 3D effect :)

notes.title: Make your Move - Update Alpha v0.1.7
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][b]------------ DEVLOG: UPDATE INFO PANELS --------------[/b][/p][p]Hello all! Here is the first patch, I have been doing some minor fixes and remaking the info panel system at all. 
[/p][p][b]------------ CHANGELOG --------------[/b][/p][list][*][p]Audio: Some sfx has been added when the tiles are show in the top panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Texts: Fixed a lot of item descriptions that had errors or missplaced in game.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies: Stats balance in enemies level 1 because it can appears at early and could kill the player without possibility to contest.[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities: Mage Thunder ability had an error that only target 1 enemy now it fixed to 2 targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Info system: Major update, the system has been changed at all, now is full responsive, all the info is available on hover (like effects description) and how is placed in the panel has changed too to be more clear to read. Any feedback is welcome 👍[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks all that have download and play Make your Move. If you have any feedback feel free to enter [/p][p]Discord Server [url="https://discord.gg/VG6M5VKx"]https://discord.gg/VG6M5VKx[/url] or use the comments 😊​[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/ec739795a7efb629a1d2d968bb14c54ee16676a0.gif"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: Audio: Some sfx has been added when the tiles are show in the top panel.

tags.bug: Texts: Fixed a lot of item descriptions that had errors or missplaced in game.

tags.balance_change: Enemies: Stats balance in enemies level 1 because it can appears at early and could kill the player without possibility to contest.

tags.bug: Abilities: Mage Thunder ability had an error that only target 1 enemy now it fixed to 2 targets.

tags.feature: Info system: Major update, the system has been changed at all, now is full responsive, all the info is available on hover (like effects description) and how is placed in the panel has changed too to be more clear to read. Any feedback is welcome 👍

notes.title: Thanks for all the support!
notes.content: [h1]Ty for supporting Make your Move [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/ec739795a7efb629a1d2d968bb14c54ee16676a0.gif"][/img][/h1][p][/p][p]About a month ago I first published a Steam page without knowing how the game was going to be received. Today I can say almost in disbelief that Make your Move is going to reach 1000 wishlist.[/p][p][/p][p]To all the people who have wanted to support the game in any way, thank you very much.[/p][p][/p][p]1- Adding the saving and loading system, which has meant a big refactoring of the game code.[/p][p][/p][p]2- I have improved the combination system for the tiles during the use of the cube, which allows to add more variety of combinations to the game. Currently there are a total of 20 combinations that I would like to increase.[/p][p][/p][p]3- Finish at a basic level the system during the Runs. Right now in the game, you can already use panels such as the map, victory and defeat, enemy effects, item selections such as chests and shops (in which I have also added the option to sell items).[/p][p]I have also added basic potions to the list of items that can be used.[/p][p][/p][p]4- Following on from point 3, you can now start a Run and finish it.[/p][p][/p][p]And finally, right now I'm focusing on creating item icons to make the equipment lists, and I'm also working on finishing the first version of the playtest.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm attaching some images with the sets I've made so far. Thanks again and see you next time 😊. If you want more information the [url="https://discord.gg/PwFdwdDY" style="button" buttoncolor="#554080"]Discord[/url] is already available! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/ec739795a7efb629a1d2d968bb14c54ee16676a0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Image sets 01[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/91989335a2085c073fe79fedd5fa4cf95f9467b3.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Image sets 02[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/bebc493f93bb295e7334a862caa126d89c1be729.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: 1- Adding the saving and loading system, which has meant a big refactoring of the game code.

2- I have improved the combination system for the tiles during the use of the cube, which allows to add more variety of combinations to the game. Currently there are a total of 20 combinations that I would like to increase.

3- Finish at a basic level the system during the Runs. Right now in the game, you can already use panels such as the map, victory and defeat, enemy effects, item selections such as chests and shops (in which I have also added the option to sell items).
I have also added basic potions to the list of items that can be used.
4- Following on from point 3, you can now start a Run and finish it.
